com.ea.ios.fifamobile.n:
This is a whole new season of EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile! The 27 Season Update puts The World’s Game right in your hands! Shift the focus back to your club with game-changing tactical freedom, an intense squad-building challenge mode, and revolutionary PlayStyles designed to elevate your matchday experience.

 NEW 27 FEATURES

GAME PLANS & DYNAMIC TACTICS
 Take full control of your team's tactical identity with the new Game Plan system.
 -In-Match Switching: Adapt on the fly by changing formations and mentalities dynamically mid-match.
 -5 Mentality Tiers: Fine-tune your strategy across Ultra Defensive, Defensive, Balanced, Attacking, and Ultra Attacking.
 -Custom Presets: Create and save up to 4 distinct Game Plans to switch between instantly during matches.

GAUNTLET MODE
 Take on the FC Mobile Gauntlet through a series of challenging rounds that test your squad depth and tactical skills.
 - Each round features unique Match Objectives, Traits, and House Rules.
 - House Rules such as Hot Zone, Position Hero, and No Rules can also change how each match plays.
 - Strategic Squad Management: Player Items have limited appearances per run, forcing you to rotate your roster.
 -Progress through nodes, earn Stars, and unlock milestone Rewards.

GAMEPLAY UPDATES
 Two new PlayStyles bring player abilities to life:
 - Incisive Through Pass: Thread through-balls with improved target selection and greater lead distance.
 - Dead Ball: Bend free kicks with increased curl, pace, dip, and precision.

AUDIO & VISUALS
 - Localized Matchday Energy: Feel the passion of the crowd with updated, immersive localized commentary in Mexican Spanish, Indonesian, and Thai.
 - Signature Celebrations: Express your victories in style with brand-new iconic goal celebrations, including "Predator", "Flex", "Fist Pump", "Rockstar", and "Tuxedo"!
 - Enjoy an overall visual refresh of the game in this new season update.

Play The World’s Game, anywhere.

Play The World’s Game update. Compete in a global soccer tournament and lead your national team to glory. Experience authentic player attributes with Playstyles that bring athletes' unique abilities to life.  Instantly connect with friends & play PVP in Quick Match. FC Mobile now supports Hindi, Czech & Polish The World’s Game Update also features a brand new nostalgia-themed soundtrack.

THE WORLD’S GAME TOURNAMENT
Compete vs the world in The World’s Game international soccer tournament. Choose from over 50 national teams, including Brazil, Portugal, England, USA and help them lift the cup. Play through tournament brackets or customize your matches & earn rewards based on difficulty and performance. The journey is more cinematic than ever with new opening videos, and soundtrack and broadcast packages.

PLAYSTYLES
Go beyond attributes with PlayStyles. This feature brings unique athlete abilities to life, making players feel more realistic. PlayStyles icons now appear on 3D player items and update in real-time during matches and set pieces. You can also see which PlayStyles were activated during post-goal showcases. From Finesse Expert curves to Bruiser physicality, feel the tangible impact of signature traits on every play.

Achievements are now part of your FC Mobile journey!
Play matches, score goals, train players, and climb the ranks to unlock achievements that celebrate your biggest milestones. Each one marks a key step in your soccer career — and you can proudly showcase them in Apple’s Games app or Game Center.

- Division Rivals Matches
- Goals
- Leaderboard Rank Ups
- Player Training & Rank Ups
- Total Matches Played
- League Friendlies

Celebrate your biggest soccer moments and show them off to friends through Apple’s Games app or Game Center.
- FC Rookie: Complete 1 match
- Emerging Talent: Complete 2 Division Rivals matches
- Elite Contender: Complete 50 Division Rivals matches
- Matchday Warrior: Complete 100 Division Rivals matches

- Seasoned Striker: Score 50 goals

EA SPORTS FC™ MOBILE 26 Update - The Club Is Yours
The FC Mobile 26 Update brings a fresh new look and major feature upgrades across visuals, gameplay, and personalization, inspired by the fans. From an updated Matchmaking Lobby to updated player face likenesses and tactical formations, this update delivers an even more authentic and rewarding soccer experience.

REVAMPED MATCHMAKING LOBBY
In the newly updated PVP match lobby, both your captain and your opponent's captain stand face-to-face, showcasing new vanity items and bringing more immersive head-to-head competition to the game.

TEAM BADGE SYSTEM
Collect and equip Team Badges to earn powerful attribute boosts for your team. Strategically fill badge slots in your lineup, track your collection progress, and earn extra season rewards by completing badge sets or player collections.

UPDATED PLAYER FACE LIKENESSES & MEMORABLE GOALS
Over 100+ updated face likenesses of star players bring them to life. Plus, celebrate in style with new post-goal celebrations.

NEW FORMATIONS
Test out new tactical setups, including the highly requested 4-2-1-3 and 4-1-3-2, giving you more flexibility in both PvP and PvE matches.

NEW COMMENTARY & AUDIO
New Turkish and Polish commentary. Updated sound effects and event music bring more energy to every match.

GAMEPLAY REFINEMENTS
Experience more balanced and dynamic gameplay with smarter Referee foul detection, reduced Kickoff Rush effectiveness, improved passing accuracy, and faster, more agile dribbling. Accuracy tied more closely to attributes & driven ground passes are easier to control.

OTHER UPDATES
Discover new tools and features beyond the pitch, including Player Compare, which lets you line up player items side-by-side to review both basic and advanced stats. Security improvements behind the scenes help us combat cheating and ensure fair-play. Plus, enjoy smoother FCMTV streaming in Extra Time and progressive rewards the longer you watch for select live broadcasts.

Enjoy even more licensed soccer content from the new 25/26 season of soccer, including 19,000+ players from 690 teams across 35 leagues. Update now to enjoy upgraded features, new ways to play, and more reasons to celebrate.

EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile’s Rivals Update is here!
Bring your Ultimate Team to glory with a complete overhaul of Division Rivals. Climb up the ranks in EA SPORTS FC Mobile's PVP modes with a new star-based rank system, redesigned interface, and rewards.
Step into the redesigned Locker Room and select your favourite kits, stadiums, logos, emotes, and name boards to flex your style on the biggest stage.
On the pitch, gameplay has been enhanced with more responsive ground passing and VS Attack rebalancing.

Division Rivals Overhaul
Redesigned Interface
-Division Rivals features a streamlined layout to help you track progress, see rewards, and manage your lineups.
-New pre-match hub that highlights your key Player and Division progress.
-Track your performance with a new season recap.

New Star-Based Rank System
-Collect Stars to climb up the Divisions and become an FC Champion.
-Star Shields help safeguard your position from relegation after tough losses.
-Earn new Division promotion rewards as you climb the ranks.

Weekly Leaderboards & Rewards
-Compete in weekly Leaderboards to earn rewards based on your performance.
-Win daily matches to earn extra rewards throughout the week.

Upgraded Locker Room
-Easily select your kit, logo, stadium, emotes, and name board to flex your style.
-Show off on the leaderboards with the new name board.
-Choose different kits for Home and Away Matches.

Gameplay Updates
Passing & Build-Up Play
-Ground Passes now better align with your aim and teammate movement, momentum, and positioning.
-Ground Through Passes lead more effectively when space is available and are less likely to overshoot along the sidelines.
-Driven Ground Passes are now more accurate and better avoid defenders based on context.

VS Attack Improvements
-Basic, Good, and Great Chances have been reworked to better reflect difficulty and quality.
-Chances end faster after saves, tackles, long fouls, or missed crosses to get you back into the action.
-New camera settings available.

More Fixes & Improvements
-Heel to Heel and Stepover & Exit now scale with player attributes, reducing speed bursts.
-Defenders with better height and jumping stats are now prioritized in central areas on corner kicks.
-Fixed an issue where the camera would remain stuck after a blocked free kick.

Compete Head to Head and earn rewards for your squad in the Rivals Update in EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile!

EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile’s League Update is here! Featuring expanded Leagues and gameplay improvements to elevate your game experience.
Leagues now support up to 100 members. Complete Seasonal Quests, climb the Leaderboards and earn rewards through League vs. League Tournaments. The refined passing, defending, and fluid gameplay make each match more engaging. Try them out now!

League Update
- Expanded Capacity: Updated Leagues now support up to 100 members, fostering better community interaction and teamwork.
- Collaborative Quests: Team up with League members in season-long Quests to earn rewards and increase your League’s rank on the Leaderboards.
- Seasonal Rewards: Earn rewards and Bonuses based on your League contributions. These rewards recognize both individual effort and League-wide achievements that underscore your League’s power and skill level.
- Leaderboards and Tournaments: Compete in tournaments to climb Global and Group Leaderboards, showcasing your League’s prowess and signifying your League’s standing.
- League Achievements: Boost your league's prestige with fresh achievements that highlight your team's collective feats. These accolades are perfect for bragging about your league's commitment and success across various challenges.
- Enhanced Management Tools: Simplify League management with new tools for handling memberships and settings.

Gameplay Enhancements
- Pass Mastery: Ground and Through Passes are now more accurate, giving you better control in tight situations and during open play.
- Dynamic Defending: Defence has been upgraded to reward skill, accuracy, and timing. Successful Stand Tackles will now cause the Opponent Dribbler to stumble or even fall, greatly increasing your chances of retrieving the ball.
- AI and Movement Improvements: Encounter smarter opposition with updated AI that scales to provide a more challenging experience.
- Improved End of Half Decision: Gameplay now continues more seamlessly around half-time, preventing abrupt stops and ensuring a fair end to each half.
- H2H Balancing: Skill moves like Heel to Heel and Open Fake Shot have been adjusted to create a fairer balance between dribblers and defenders. The Skill Move Stun effect has been removed entirely.

Visual Improvements
- New Weather added: Enjoy more realistic matches with the introduction of snow weather conditions.
- Visual Improvements: The enhanced visual effects include brighter highlights on jerseys and shoes and a more pronounced depth of field during player introductions and goal celebrations.
- Lineup Management: Players eligible for upgrades are now marked with clearer indicators for easy management.
- Increased Frame Rates: Higher-end devices can enjoy smoother, visually stunning gameplay with increased frame rates and enhanced graphic quality

Bug Fixes
- Club Challenge Icons: Corrected a misrepresentation by swapping the icons for Top Scorer and Most Assists in the Club Challenge winner screen.
- Club Challenge Winning Page: Fixed

As UEFA EURO 2024™ wraps up, this update focuses on resolving key live issues to enhance your gameplay experience. With these improvements, exciting new events await your exploration. As always, stay tuned in to our EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile (formerly FIFA Mobile) social channels for additional live updates!

We’ve made improvements and fixes in the following areas:

Training Transfer:
Attribute Display Fixed: Corrected display errors on the Training Transfer Success screen to ensure attributes are shown accurately.
Transfer Eligibility Fix: Fixed a bug where the source player card with 0 Training Level remained selectable for transfer, despite having no Training Level to transfer.
Experience Overflow Fix: Corrected a bug where the XP of the source player card incorrectly increased due to overflow from a fully trained target player card.
Animation Restoration: Fixed an issue where the animation for a successful training transfer was missing.

Key Match:
Home and Away Team Display Fix: Corrected an issue where home and away team names were reversed at the end of matches when playing as the away team.
Difficulty Display Fix: Corrected a display error where, when forfeiting a match at any difficulty level other than "Amateur," the difficulty was incorrectly shown as "Amateur."

Exchange Interface:
Currency Display Fix: Corrected a visual glitch where the Currency bar disappeared when navigating back from player details within the Exchange interface.

See you on the pitch!

com.s01.global.n:
[New Content]
1. Secured Alliance Gathering Node:
A new feature that provides a safe resource gathering location for alliance members.
- Unlock Condition: Available once the Empire reaches a certain progression point.
- Gathering Rules: After placement, alliance members can gather resources without being attacked. Each member can only send one squad to gather.
2. Lord Gear and Lord Charm Material Exchange:
- Lords can exchange excess materials in the Gear interface for Gear and Charm-related items. Make good use of resources and boost your power! (Becomes available when empires reach a certain progress).

[Optimizations and Adjustments]
1. Eternity's Reach Optimizations:
(1) Improved ranking rewards with new Oasis Island buildings
(2) Improved prompts for using Sanctuary Skills for clearer controls
(3) Added an option to switch the displayed sign-up time for easier viewing
(4) Adjusted the number of players on the battlefield for fairer competition
2. Hero Adjustment:
Fixed an issue where "Hera"'s Expedition Skill, "Sundering Wound", would not take effect in certain situations.
3. Resource Gathering Screen Optimization:
- Added a display for Gathering Bonus effects and a quick-access button to the City Bonuses - "Growth" tab for effortless viewing and usage of Gathering Speed items.
4. Rally Optimization:
- Added a new Starred feature to Rallies. By starring a Lord's Rally, all future Rallies launched by them will be listed first in Alliance Wars.
5. World Map Optimization:
- New Entry: World map now has a "Wilderness" quick-access entry for wilderness towns.
6. Arena Optimization:
- New Prompts: Formation interface now includes hero upgrade prompts and quick-access buttons for convenient progression.
7. Castle Battle Optimizations:
- Directional Indicators: Turret names now include directional markers (North, South, East, West) for easier location.
8. Teleport Feature Optimizations:
(1) [Territory Teleporter] now supports free dragging, allowing Lords to choose their destination before confirming the teleport.
(2) Wilderness Teleport: When teleporting in the wilderness, if the target location is within your alliance's territory, the Territory Teleport feature will be prioritized.
9. Added a Sort by Hero Type feature to show the heroes in a different order.
10. Added Daily Missions for Realm Trial.
11. Mission Progress Bar Optimizations:
Optimized mission progress bars for events such as Alliance Mobilization and Hall of Lords, making progress clear at a glance.
12. Art and Visual Optimizations:
(1) Improved the visuals of some beasts and environments on the world map.
(2) Improved the visuals of some Oasis Island buildings.

[New Content]
1. New Feature [Oasis Island]: The sailors are ready and awaiting your command! Set sail in search of the legendary Oasis Island and build a new home.
2. New Feature [Realm Trial]: Take on challenges across six themed zones: the Radiant Spire, Molten Fort, Knowledge Nexus, Coliseum, Crystal Cave, and Forest of Life. Clear stages to earn generous rewards.
3. Comprehensive Skin System Upgrade:
(1) Added new skin categories for [Name Card], [Chat], [Rally], [Teleport], and [Profile], offering even more ways to express yourself.
(2) Added the [Throne Bastion] Castle Skin and [Dueler] March Skin.
(3) Added multiple new skins, including the [Empire Radiance] and [Guardian Army] Avatar Frames, the [Empire Radiance] and [Guardian Army] Nameplates, and the [Gem Shower] and [Cool] Emotes.
4. Added the [Lord Profile - Mood] feature: Set your Mood Status to let other Lords know how you feel and make interactions more fun.
5. Added the [Alliance Bomb] feature: Alliance officers can deploy bombs within their Alliance territory to clear Resource Nodes not being gathered by any Lord, as well as Beasts and Terrors, making Teleporting more convenient.
6. Added [Alliance Mobilization Mission Vouchers]: Use them to quickly refresh missions during Alliance Mobilization and select the mission type.
7. Added the [Empire Waystation]: Eligible Lords can unlock the [Empire Waystation] in the Top-up Center and purchase Empire Star Packs. Some packs also include bonus gifts to empower your journey across the Empire.
8. Added the [Empire Radiance Gift] event: Reward tiers are determined by each Lord's highest Top-up Points from a single payment. Once your highest Top-up Points from a single payment meet the specified requirement, you can claim rewards including the animated [Cool] Emote, permanent [Empire Radiance Name Card] Skin, permanent [Empire Radiance] Chat Skin, abundant resources, and Empire Stars.
Reminder: If your historical highest Top-up Points from a single payment already meet the corresponding requirement, you can claim the relevant rewards as soon as the event begins.
9. Added the [Empire Supreme Gift] event: Reward tiers are determined by each Lord's total Top-up Points accumulated in a single day. Accumulate the required Top-up Points on any day between 00:00:00 and 23:59:59 UTC to claim rewards including the permanent [Empire's Call] Teleport Skin.
Reminder: If your historical total Top-up Points on any single day already meet the corresponding requirement, you can claim the relevant rewards as soon as the event begins.

[Optimizations and Adjustments]
1. Pack Adjustment: "Fast Development Pack" has become unavailable after this update and can no longer be purchased when removed. A brand-new pack has been released at the same time, please check it out.
2. Several new reward tiers will be added to the "Top-up Gift" event. Complete them to obtain permanent skins: "Empire Radiance Avatar Frame" and "Empire Radiance Nameplate", along with many ra

[Optimizations & Adjustments]
1. Alliance Optimizations:
(1) Added Alliance Whitelist. Whitelisted lords can skip the application approval process and join the Alliance quickly. Alliances that have whitelisted you will also appear first in the Alliance list, helping you quickly return to a familiar team.
(2) Alliance Notices now support likes and dislikes, allowing members to give instant feedback.
(3) Added Alliance Rules to help allies get up to speed quickly.

2. Bear Hunt:
Added Personal Damage Achievement rewards. After the update, lords who participate in Bear Hunt can earn the new Total Historical Personal Damage Achievement rewards for even greater gains.
*The above adjustments will take effect after the update. Damage dealt to "Raging Bear" before the update will not be counted, so please plan your game time accordingly.

3. Prestige Benefits:
(1) Players on servers that have been open for 15 days and have reached VIP Lv. 12 can access Prestige Benefits from the VIP screen.
Benefits include Prestige Spinner and Prestige Shop. Spend Top-up Points to draw Prestige Badges, which can be exchanged for limited rewards.
(2) Added the City Skin [Eternal Throne], March Skin [Hurricane of Destruction], Avatar Frame [Heart of Eternity Avatar Frame], and Nameplate [Heart of Eternity]. All can be obtained through Prestige Benefits.

4. Formation Feature Optimizations:
(1) Added Formation name settings. You can customize Formation names using up to 3 letters or numbers for clearer management.
(2) Increased the current formation cap by adding 2 formation slots, unlocked when the Town Center reaches Lv. 26 and Lv. 30 respectively.
(3) Once your Town Center reaches Lv. 19, the Formation screen will support saving presets by soldier quantity or soldier type ratio.

5. Gesture Control Optimizations:
Added the Swipe Back feature, which can be enabled in Settings. Swipe left or right from the edge of the screen to quickly switch pages.

6. Desert Trial:
During the event, Dreadwolves can now be quickly found and attacked from the Wilderness Search screen, making it easier to join in.

7. Visual Optimization:
Optimized the appearance of the [Burst of Life] City Skin.

[Bug Fixes]
1. Auto Hunting Optimizations:
Fixed an issue where [Lord Stamina] was not automatically refunded after a battle was terminated under rare circumstances.

[Optimizations and Adjustments]
1. Gathering Carriage Visual Optimization: The appearance of the carriage has been optimized to better match the game's overall style.
2. March Visual Optimization: Fixed an issue where the [Prismatic Aide] March Skin had no ground shadow.
3. Screen Adaptation: Added a non-standard screen edge spacing adaptation feature to setting.
4. Chat Emote Optimization: Applied style optimizations to some of the King's emote.
5. City Weather Optimization: Reduced the frequency of full cloudy day on the city map.
The throne awaits its rightful ruler.

com.everywear.game5.n:
Autumn leaves are giving way to the first snowflakes, and Hopewell Bay is getting ready for winter! Here's what's new:

• Roll up your sleeves with Maddie and refurbish our newest area, the Factory Office!
• Watch Hopewell Bay transform into a snowy winter wonderland!
• Enjoy a variety of fun events as the holiday season draws near!

Have a great time with Merge Mansion!
Small fixes and improvements. Thank you for playing Merge Mansion.

Autumn is arriving, and Hopewell Bay is buzzing with activity! Our latest update includes:

• Maddie and company unravel the classy mystique of our latest area; the Parlor.
• Once the Renaissance Faire closes, a magical mystery is in store for Hallows' Eve with Maddie at the helm!
• Enjoy exciting and spooky events, along with a Season Pass full of rewards!

Have a great time with Merge Mansion!

Fresh discoveries and sparkling celebrations are coming to Hopewell Bay! Here's what awaits in our latest update:

• With harvest season nearly here, stock up and spruce up our newest area: the Pantry!
• An unearthed curiosity brings Maddie and Pearl together for a brilliant new adventure!
• Dive into exciting events and a Season Pass brimming with rewards!

Have fun with Merge Mansion!
Small fixes and improvements. Thank you for playing Merge Mansion.

Summer is in full swing, and it's time for festivities in Hopewell Bay! Here's what you can look forward to in our latest update:

• Find out what's cooking in our newest area, the Kitchen!
• After the soccer excitement, get ready to unleash Hopewell Bay's local music talent!
• Enjoy a variety of fun events and exciting Season Passes packed with rewards.
• The "Settings" button is back, making access easier, along with other fixes and improvements.

Have a fun summer in Hopewell Bay!

Summer has arrived in Hopewell Bay, and there's plenty to look forward to in our latest update!

• Maddie and her friends are gearing up for an exciting soccer watch party.
• Discover and restore the Hallway of Curiosities, our newest area filled with secrets waiting to be uncovered.
• Enjoy a lineup of fun seasonal events and brand-new Season Passes packed with rewards.
• We've also made a variety of improvements and fixes to keep your experience running smoothly.

See you in Hopewell Bay!
Small fixes and improvements. Thank you for playing Merge Mansion.

Summer is near, and something tiny is starting to make a big impact in Hopewell Bay. This update includes:

• What’s sweeter than a fresh start? A simple clean-up turns more meaningful for Maddie and Jackie.
• The Factory Floor is next to be transformed, but into what? Find out in our new area!
• A fresh season, a lively buzz of events, and nonstop fun ahead!
• Improvements and fixes to keep things running smoothly.

Spring blooms in Hopewell Bay, and Maddie is as busy as ever! In this update:

• Jackie rescues a fluffy stray, and Maddie hops in to help!
• Revamp, not just refurbish in our newest area, the Gift Shop!
• Celebrate with lively springtime events and surprises.
• Improvements and fixes to keep things running smoothly.
Small fixes and improvements. Thank you for playing Merge Mansion.
Small fixes and improvements. Thank you for playing Merge Mansion.

Grandma returns from Japan, but there's always more to uncover in Hopewell Bay.
This update includes:

• In the upcoming pass, spring-cleaning uncovers new mysteries after Grandma shares her story from Japan.
• Espionage and spy craft in the mansion? Find out in the new area.
• A mix of events, including a chilling event never seen before!
• Improvements and enhancements to better the game.

As the mystery of the game board culminates, fresh energy and surprises arrive in Hopewell Bay. Here's what's in store:

• Grandma has vanished to unravel the mystery of the Go board, and an adorable new hoofed companion arrives at the Mansion!
• Complete the Walk-in Closet refurbishing and uncover the secrets hidden within.
• Enjoy a charming mix of fun events to keep the excitement going.
• Plus, improvements and enhancements for an even better experience.

As the mystery of the game board culminates, fresh energy and surprises arrive in Hopewell Bay. Here's what's in store:

• Grandma has vanished to unravel the mystery of the Go board, and an adorable new hoofed companion arrives at the Mansion!
• Complete the Walk-in Closet refurbishing and uncover the secrets hidden within.
• Enjoy a charming mix of fun events to keep the excitement going.
• Plus, improvements and enhancements for an even better experience.

A new year is here, and as the holiday festivities fade in Hopewell Bay, here's what's coming your way:
• Step into the Walk-in Closet, a brand-new area where a wardrobe of past mysteries is waiting to be explored.
• Maddie uncovers an old family heirloom, an antique Go board with a mysterious past. What secrets does it hold?
• A range of improvements and enhancements to make your experience better.
Improvements to the overall game experience.

In Hopewell Bay, the leaves fall and the season shifts; here's what's coming in this update:

 • Step inside Grandma's room… mysteries await! Discover them all in the latest area.
 • Grandma receives an unexpected love letter… will it end in heartbreak?
 • A new set of clues to collect, and later, a furry companion to adore!
 • As winter arrives, take part in our holiday events and collect decorations!
Small fixes and improvements. Thank you for playing Merge Mansion.
Small fixes and improvements. Thank you for playing Merge Mansion!

Pumpkins are glowing, ghosts are stirring – Halloween is almost here! Here's what's creeping into the latest update:

 • Step inside the Tin Can Factory and restore a brand-new area: the Reception!
 • New item levels await for the Garden Toolbox, Broom Cabinet, and Tools.
 • Spooktacular Halloween events and new Mystery Passes will keep the thrills going.
 • We've also exorcized some bugs and made other improvements for a smoother experience.
Small fixes and improvements. Thank you for playing Merge Mansion.

As the leaves turn, sweater weather brings new stories to Hopewell Bay. This update includes:

• Explore and refurbish a new area, the Boulton Boulevard!
• Something boo-tiful floats onto Grandma's porch, ready to fall under its spell?
• Maddie is back in a metropolis, but not Paris, where's she off to?
• Fun-filled events and two new Mystery Passes to keep you entertained.
• Improvements and fixes to enhance your experience!

It has been an eventful summer in Hopewell Bay, but more's to come. The update includes:

• Discover Maddie's family secrets in the new area: the Parents' Room!
• Pablo's ferocious appetite sparks a funeral; what could be afoot?
• Celebrate Merge Mansion's 5th anniversary!
• Two new Mystery Passes and a host of events to keep you entertained!
• Improvements and enhancements to better your gaming experience.
Small fixes and improvements. Thank you for playing Merge Mansion.

com.project.idle.cd.n:
【New Features and Improvements】
1. Added an extra confirmation prompt when starting "Joint Exercise".
2. After cross-server raiding unlocks, a prompt warns when raiding a Covert Mission on your own server.
3. Added local/server time switching for some events; scheduling automatically shows local time based on the selected server time.
4. Increased the Presidential Mail character limit.

【New and Optimizations】
1. Added automatic approval for "President Item" authorization requests. When the President enables auto-approval, requests on the list will be approved in order.
2. Optimized the in-game local time display to accommodate seasonal time changes.
3. Optimized the loot claim limit in "Nuclear Reckoning" and added the option to share loot in chat channels.

1. New Sunday event: Battlefield Assault.
2. New large-scale cross-server event: Nuclear Reckoning.
3. New Alliance Announcement Templates.
4. Offline notifications added for selected events.
5. New offline notifications for the Alliance Train.
6. Auto-challenge the next Main Campaign stage after clearing Stage 550.

【Optimizations】
1. Expanded the Total Hero Power ranking eligibility for the Intermediate Commander Arena to the top 1,000 players.
2. Reduced the number of Red Grunts required for the Daily Task “Defeat Red Grunts” to 2.
3. Added a Raging Bay event time reminder to the To-Do List.
4. Reduced the difficulty of some City Recon event stages in Radar Tasks.

【New】
1. Added Alliance Image Sharing
2. Added Alliance Star
3. Added the large-scale cross-server battlefield event Star Core Collection War
4. Added game languages: Polish, Turkish, Russian, Italian, and Japanese
5. Added new animation displays for Daisy and Brock

【Improvements】
